policy_title: National and Local Citizens' Assemblies for Climate Change
stated: Establish national and local citizens’ assemblies to give people real involvement in the decisions needed to tackle climate change.

source.quote: Establish national and local citizens’ assemblies to give people real involvement in the decisions needed to tackle climate change.

bearing_set.reason: The assemblies' explicit purpose is to shape climate-change decisions; deliberative assemblies (e.g. UK Climate Assembly 2020, Irish Citizens' Assembly) have historically generated more ambitious and publicly-legitimate climate recommendations, producing a real — if contingent — projected effect on emissions trajectory and environmental outcomes.

National and local citizens' assemblies are a direct democratic participation mechanism, materially expanding the 'fair say' and democratic-rights indicators under O9 beyond conventional electoral routes.

Structured deliberative assemblies directly increase civic participation — an explicit O15 indicator — and at both national and local scale plausibly affect social trust and sense of belonging among participants and the wider community.

membership_note: Three bearings: O6 (climate outcomes, the stated purpose), O9 (democratic participation/fair say), and O15 (civic participation and social trust). No coercive element so O10 is not engaged; fiscal cost of the assemblies themselves is negligible relative to O12 thresholds; no direct effect on housing, pay, health, education, or other fundamentals.
